Hiring desk

From application to interview, offer, hire, contract, orientation, and desk login — one file at a time.

Blank forms
Hiring standards & paper path

Every candidate fills out an application, clears eligibility, interviews with HR, and starts on a seven-day probation. City standing and a clear recent felony record are required. Terrorism charges or murder of a government employee are a hard bar.

Before hire: Issue application → clear eligibility → issue invitation → issue interviewer questions → record notes → issue offer → hire onto roster.

After hire: Issue contract (company signs first) → file signed reply → issue new-hire packet → issue account login information (desk access granted when the acknowledgement is filed).

Filed replies
Signed returns on file — newest first. Each filed reply marks that hiring step complete.
How hiring packets work
  1. Issue downloads a fillable .html packet and posts a formal notice to the hiring channel. The applicant does not fill the form inside this desk.
  2. The applicant completes every required field, signs, selects Download reply, and returns that completed .html file to Human Resources.
  3. Import reply files the return under Filed replies, advances the pipeline where appropriate, and posts a step-complete notice to Discord.

Employee handbook — excerpts

Welcome to Frenchie's

Welcome to the family. Frenchie's is a working restaurant at 8 Elgin Ave in Legion Square. You are expected to show up in uniform, on time, and ready to look after the guests. Treat the staff beside you the way you would treat a paying customer. Anything you cannot solve on the floor, you bring to a Shift Lead. Anything the Shift Lead cannot solve, they bring to Operations or to me.

Chain of command

Owner → Operations Manager and HR Director → Shift Lead → Cook, Waiter, Hostess → New Hire. Go one rung at a time. Skipping the ladder without cause is itself a conduct issue.

  • Samael Hesperus — Owner — 5869124
  • Kenzie Long — HR Director — 636
  • Leon Wagner — Operations Manager — 3956037

Probation

Every new hire serves a seven-day probation. During probation you are shadowed, trained on a station, and reviewed by HR at the end of the week. Pass and you move onto the ladder proper. Fall short and we part ways without prejudice.

Three-strike discipline

  • Strike one — verbal warning, noted in your file.
  • Strike two — written warning with a follow-up review date.
  • Strike three — termination.

Suspension may be issued at any point while a matter is being looked into. Theft from the register, violence toward guests or staff, and showing up to a shift unfit to work are immediate escalations.

Radio codes

  • 10-1 — clocking in
  • 10-2 — clocking out
  • 10-4 — understood / acknowledged
  • 10-20 — your current location
  • 10-99 — emergency, all hands

Bar register

The bar register runs a flat $1,000 rate per the handbook. That figure is the counter price the guest pays — it is not a wage, a payroll rate, or anything that touches your pay stub. Wages are hours × your role rate, paid Sunday 12:00 AM (midnight) at Frenchie's.

Payday

Payroll runs Sunday at 12:00 AM (midnight). Come by Frenchie's for pay. Hours are logged by HR through the week — if your hours look wrong, raise it before Sunday, not after.

Desk build changelog

    Tip: Ctrl/Cmd+K anytime. Esc closes.

    Desk settings

    Sign-in

    6+ digit PIN, stored hashed. After hashing, hire papers say “ask HR” — share the PIN privately. Owner may keep a personal master password.

    Payroll tips

    Tip pool is only what HR enters for Sunday settlement. Staff keep 100% of tips they earn — tips are not company income.

    Discord channel links (Owner & HR Director)

    Owner & HR Director. Paste each Discord channel post link (from Discord Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks). These stay on this browser — not shared with other desks.

    Cloud office (Owner & HR Director)

    Owner & HR Director. Connects Discord income and live desk updates. The office URL + access key travel with shared office files so staff can listen without opening Settings. Channel links stay local. Host file link is under Backup.

    Desk prefs

    Select Payment Source

    Select the account or source funding this payout. This tags the transaction and automatically logs an expense entry.
